
# Instructions for ShadowClone Game Project

## Project
- Build a 2D puzzle-platformer named ShadowClone.
- Engine: Godot 4.x Standard.
- Language: GDScript, not C#.
- Targets: Windows PC and Android.
- Renderer: Compatibility.
- Use a clean, modular, beginner-friendly architecture.

## Hardware constraints
- Development computer has 8 GB RAM and a dedicated GPU.
- Keep scenes, textures, shaders, and scripts lightweight.
- Avoid unnecessary dependencies and heavy assets.
- Prefer testing on a real Android device when possible.

## Coding rules
- Use valid Godot 4 GDScript syntax.
- Use static typing where practical.
- Use clear, consistent English names for files and variables.
- Add Vietnamese comments to explain important logic.
- Avoid deprecated APIs.
- Do not invent nonexistent nodes, methods, or project settings.
- Keep input, gameplay, UI, and level logic separated.
- Reuse existing files instead of duplicating them.

## AI workflow
- Inspect the existing project before changing files.
- Make small, testable changes.
- Explain which files are created or modified.
- Never overwrite working code without checking its purpose.
- Do not claim that the game works without testing it.
- If a test fails, inspect the actual error and fix the root cause.
- Never delete project files or Git history without permission.

## Deliverables
- Provide a playable prototype before adding advanced features.
- Include a main menu, gameplay, pause, victory, and restart flow.
- Keep PC keyboard input and Android touch controls in mind.
- Explain how to run and export the project.
